briefs.title: Why Minimalist Phones Are Making a Quiet Comeback
paragraphs: Across major cities, young professionals are increasingly reluctant to spend every waking hour glued to endless social feeds.
Instead of upgrading to larger screens, many are adopting minimalist devices or monochrome interfaces to curb digital fatigue and reclaim deep focus.

reluctant.example: She was reluctant to share her password.

curb.example: New habits help curb late-night scrolling.

briefs.title: The Science Behind Five-Minute Micro-Learning
paragraphs: Neuroscientists have long observed that brief, frequent study sessions outperform marathon cramming when building long-term memory.
By spacing repetition right before a memory fades, learners reinforce neural pathways effortlessly during daily commutes.
